caption:
Toto spent ages at the salon basin with his head tipped right back, and now his neck aches after every haircut.

Necks often don't love staying fully tipped back for long. A little support behind the neck can take some of the load off.

Hybi's basin tips: ask for a rolled towel behind your neck, sit with your hips close to the basin, and speak up early if it's uncomfortable. Afterwards, a few slow neck turns can help you loosen up.

Dizziness, blurred vision or arm tingling mean stop and get checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
